hook.line: At the public hearing, nobody says *I agree with you* like they would at the café. When Tomás answers the council, he needs the careful, formal version.

examples.es: Comparto su punto de vista, aunque tengo una duda.
examples.en: I share your view, although I have one doubt. (formal)
I fully agree with what has been said.
I fully agree with you all.

examples.es: Comparto su preocupación por el edificio.
examples.en: I share your concern about the building. (formal)
We completely agree with the proposal.

rule:
At a hearing, in a meeting or in a letter, *estoy de acuerdo* can sound a bit plain. Two upgrades:

*Comparto* + *su punto de vista*, *su opinión*, *su preocupación*. There is no *con*: you share the thing itself.
*Coincido con* + a person or an idea. Add *plenamente* or *totalmente* to say *fully*.

With *usted* use *su*. With a friend it becomes *tu punto de vista*, but then it sounds like you're speaking to a committee, so a friend gets *Estoy de acuerdo* instead.

The polite brake is *aunque tengo una duda*: *although I have one doubt*.
smallPrint: Teachers call this the formal register for expressing agreement.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *comparto* or *compartimos*, then type the whole sentence: ___ su punto de vista. (I share your view, to a stranger.)
yourTurn.why: One person speaking means *comparto*, and *usted* means *su*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *tu* or *su*, then type the whole sentence: Comparto ___ punto de vista. (I share your view, to a council member you've just met.)
yourTurn.why: A formal stranger gets *usted*, so the word is *su*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: I share your concern. (formal)
yourTurn.why: *Compartir* takes the thing itself, with no *con*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: I fully agree with what has been said.
yourTurn.why: *Coincidir* needs *con* before what you agree with.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: We completely agree with the proposal.
yourTurn.why: We is the *-mos* ending, then *con* and what you agree with.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about *we*: Comparto su opinión.
Make it friendly: Comparto su punto de vista. (to a friend)

pitfalls.wrong: Comparto con su punto de vista.
pitfalls.why: Almost. English says *share with*; here the view itself is what you share, so no *con*.

pitfalls.right: Coincido plenamente con su punto de vista.

pitfalls.wrong: Comparto su punto de vista. (said to a close friend over coffee)
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Comparto su punto de vista* is for meetings and letters. Over coffee with a friend, it sounds like you're addressing a committee.

personal: Imagine you are at the council hearing. Agree with someone you respect, starting with *Comparto su*.
